# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
|---------|--------------------|
| v3.x    | ✅ Active          |
| v2.x    | ⚠️ Critical fixes  |
| v1.x    | ❌ End of life     |
| < v1.0  | ❌ End of life     |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Please do not report security vulnerabilities via public GitHub issues.**

Email: security@propsim.aero
PGP key: [download](https://propsim.aero/.well-known/pgp-key.asc)

Response time:
- Critical: 24 hours
- High: 72 hours
- Medium: 7 days
- Low: 30 days

We follow responsible disclosure and coordinate with reporters on timing of public disclosure.
